answer.en: Yes, ripe red tomatoes are not toxic to dogs and can be an occasional treat in small amounts. Green, unripe tomatoes and the green parts of the plant are a different story and should be avoided.
answer.sl: Da, zrel rdeč paradižnik za pse ni strupen in je lahko občasen priboljšek v majhnih količinah. Zelen, nezrel paradižnik in zeleni deli rastline pa so nekaj drugega in se jim je treba izogibati.

why.en: The main toxic compounds in tomatoes are tomatine and solanine, found mostly in the green parts of the plant. As a tomato ripens and turns red, their levels drop significantly, so ripe tomatoes are considered non-toxic. Tomato-based products often contain garlic, onions, salt or sugar, which can be harmful or irritating to dogs.
why.sl: Glavni strupeni snovi v paradižniku sta tomatin in solanin, ki ju je največ v zelenih delih rastline. Ko paradižnik dozori in postane rdeč, se njuna količina močno zmanjša, zato zrel paradižnik velja za nestrupenega. Izdelki iz paradižnika pogosto vsebujejo česen, čebulo, sol ali sladkor, ki psu lahko škodijo ali ga dražijo.

what_to_do.en: Start with small amounts to see how your dog reacts, and only give tomato in moderation under supervision. If you think your dog ate a large amount of tomatoes or the tomato plant itself, call your vet for guidance.
what_to_do.sl: Začnite z majhnimi količinami, da vidite, kako se pes odzove, in paradižnik ponujajte le zmerno in pod nadzorom. Če mislite, da je pes pojedel veliko paradižnika ali samo rastlino, pokličite veterinarja za nasvet.

serving.en: Ripe, red and plain only. Remove all the green parts and dice the flesh; cut cherry tomatoes into small pieces. Never tomatoes seasoned with salt, garlic, onion or other additions.
serving.sl: Le zrel, rdeč in navaden. Odstranite vse zelene dele in meso narežite na kocke; češnjeve paradižnike narežite na majhne koščke. Nikoli paradižnika, začinjenega s soljo, česnom, čebulo ali drugimi dodatki.

child.en: Dogs can have a little ripe red tomato. A grown-up takes off the green bits and cuts it small.
child.sl: Psi lahko dobijo malo zrelega rdečega paradižnika. Odrasli odstrani zelene dele in ga nareže na majhne koščke.

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo zelen paradižnik?

a.en: No. Green tomatoes contain more tomatine and solanine than ripe ones, and eating an unripe tomato can lead to symptoms of tomatine poisoning.
a.sl: Ne. Zelen paradižnik vsebuje več tomatina in solanina kot zrel, nezrel paradižnik pa lahko povzroči znake zastrupitve s tomatinom.

q.en: Can dogs eat tomato sauce or ketchup?
q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo paradižnikovo omako ali kečap?

a.en: It's best to avoid them. Tomato-based products like sauce, ketchup and soup often contain garlic, onions, salt or sugar, which can be harmful or irritating to dogs.
a.sl: Bolje se jim je izogniti. Paradižnikovi izdelki, kot so omaka, kečap in juha, pogosto vsebujejo česen, čebulo, sol ali sladkor, ki psu lahko škodijo ali ga dražijo.

q.en: I grow tomatoes. What should I watch for?
q.sl: Gojim paradižnik. Na kaj moram paziti?

a.en: Green tomatoes that fall from the vine can attract dogs. Fence off the garden so your dog can't sample the plants.
a.sl: Zeleni plodovi, ki padejo z rastline, lahko pritegnejo pse. Vrt ogradite, da pes ne more pokusiti rastlin.
